content: The Founder picks up the stopwatch and turns it over, the way he turned the tin over on Day 1. When he speaks, he speaks to the tins. 'It took me longer than I told myself. Ops is right.' He turns round. 'Here's my call. Eight weeks stays as our target, privately. The public date comes out of the gates. Growth's split: the waitlist goes live now, the preorder link opens only when all five gates are green. If we miss the gate review in week 4, we say so publicly, in our own words, with a new date Ops signs. And for Archive 002 I'll pick something Ops can source with the suppliers and method we already have, if I can. That one's a proposal to myself, not a promise to you.'
round_time: Just after noon, Day 4 - the timeline decision

proposals.text: Founder self-proposal: choose an Archive 002 that reuses existing suppliers and painting method where possible, to protect the timeline

decisions.text: FOUNDER DECISION: 8 weeks remains an internal target; the public Archive 002 date is set by the launch gate. Waitlist goes live now; preorder link opens only when all five gates are green (product, price, spec card, remedy promise, Ops-approved dispatch date). If the week-4 gate review fails, slip is announced publicly with a new Ops-signed date
